screen.soundsculptor.title: Sound Sculptor
soundsculptor.ui.tab.usage: Press Enter to open this tab. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs.
soundsculptor.ui.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
soundsculptor.ui.unsaved.message: You have changes that are not saved. Save them before closing?
soundsculptor.demo.title: UI kit demo
soundsculptor.demo.why: Why does this sound like this?
soundsculptor.demo.slider_keys: Slider keys: Left/Right step 5, Shift+Left/Right step 1.
soundsculptor.demo.delete_message: "Trading hall" and its 3 rules will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
soundsculptor.demo.help_message: Every control here can be used with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs. Esc closes dialogs with the safest choice.
soundsculptor.demo.error.volume: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200
soundsculptor.demo.tip.bypass: Demo only: in Sound Sculptor this plays every sound as in vanilla, ignoring all rules.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.plain_button: An ordinary text button. Pressing it updates "Last action".
soundsculptor.demo.tip.disabled_button: A disabled button: it cannot be pressed and Tab skips it.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.show_cue: Show a short on-screen cue when a muted sound plays.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.reduced_motion: Turn off list animations and toast slide-ins.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.volume_slider: Volume from 0 to 200%%. Above 100%% is louder than vanilla.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.volume_typed: Type a volume from 0 to 200; the slider follows.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.pattern: A sound ID pattern. * matches any text, e.g. minecraft:entity.villager.*
soundsculptor.demo.tip.open_two: Opens a dialog with two choices. Esc picks Cancel.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.open_three: Opens a dialog with three choices. Esc picks Keep editing.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.pretend_unsaved: When on, closing this screen asks whether to save first.
soundsculptor.ui.list.usage: Press Tab to enter the list. Up and Down move between rows, Left and Right between buttons, Page Up and Page Down by a page. Tab again leaves the list.
soundsculptor.ui.dropdown.usage: Press Enter to choose. Up and Down move, Enter picks, Esc cancels.
soundsculptor.undo.stale: Can't undo: it was changed since
soundsculptor.ui.color.swatch.usage: Press Enter to choose this color
soundsculptor.demo.tip.refresh: Simulates new sounds arriving. The focused row and the scroll position stay put.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.apply_to: Where a new rule goes: everywhere, or into one zone.
soundsculptor.demo.tip.show_undo_toast: Shows a message with an Undo button for 5 seconds.
soundsculptor.recent.pause.tip: Freeze the list so you can read it. Shortcut: P while the list has focus.
soundsculptor.recent.sort.name: Name
soundsculptor.recent.filter.hint: Filter by name, ID or category
soundsculptor.recent.empty: No sounds yet. Sounds you hear appear here.
soundsculptor.settings.show_distance.tip: Show how far away each recently played sound was (Close, Near, Far). Turn off for servers that object to distance hints.
soundsculptor.bypass.tip: Turn every Sound Sculptor effect off at once (vanilla sound) without changing any rule. Hotkey: %s (on laptops you may need Fn+F10).
soundsculptor.recent.apply_to.tip: Where Mute and Edit put the rule: everywhere, or in a zone you are standing in.
soundsculptor.settings.bypass_hint: Bypass hotkey: %s. On laptops you may need Fn+F10.
soundsculptor.notice.profile_broken.titl: Sound Sculptor profile could not be loaded
soundsculptor.notice.profile_broken.mess: %s It was renamed to .broken and an empty profile is used.
soundsculptor.notice.set_broken.title: A Sound Set could not be loaded
soundsculptor.notice.set_removed.title: Sound Set removed
soundsculptor.notice.save_failed.title: Sound Sculptor could not save
soundsculptor.notice.errors.title: Sound Sculptor turned itself off
soundsculptor.notice.errors.message: Too many errors, so Bypass is on and sounds play as in vanilla. Please report this bug.
soundsculptor.rules.add.tip: Create a rule for one sound or a family of sounds, for example minecraft:entity.villager.*
soundsculptor.rules.hint: More specific patterns win. On a tie, the rule higher in the list wins.
soundsculptor.rules.empty: No rules yet. Use Add rule, or Mute on the Recently Played tab.
soundsculptor.rules.turn_off: Turn this rule off without deleting it
soundsculptor.rules.delete.title: Delete this rule?
soundsculptor.rules.delete.message: The rule for %s will be deleted. To keep it for later, turn it off instead.
soundsculptor.rule_editor.pattern.tip: Type words to find a sound (villager hurt, cow|sheep, -ambient), then pick one; or type a sound ID or a pattern where * stands for any characters, such as minecraft:entity.villager.*
soundsculptor.rule_editor.enabled.tip: Turn the rule off to stop its effect without deleting it
soundsculptor.rule_editor.mute.tip: Muted silences matching sounds. Not muted overrides a broader rule that mutes them. Unchanged leaves it to other rules and shows what the sound gets now.
soundsculptor.rule_editor.volume.tip: Loudness of matching sounds, on top of Minecraft's own volume sliders. Arrow keys change it by 5%%, Shift+arrow by 1%%.
soundsculptor.rule_editor.volume_typed.t: Type 0 to 100, or leave it empty to leave the volume unchanged (the faint number is what the sound gets now)
soundsculptor.rule_editor.matches.invali: Fix the pattern to see which sounds it matches
soundsculptor.rule_editor.matches.none: No known sound matches yet. Sounds added later by mods still can.
soundsculptor.pattern.error.empty: Type a sound ID or a pattern
soundsculptor.pattern.error.empty_part: Type something before and after the :
soundsculptor.summary.rule.limit_per_sou: At most %1$s per %2$s s, per source
soundsculptor.boost.confirm.title: Louder than vanilla?
soundsculptor.boost.confirm.body: Above 100%% the sound is louder than vanilla can play it. Loud sounds may crackle or distort, and long exposure can harm your hearing. Boost never lets you hear a sound from farther away.
soundsculptor.boost.unsupported: Your audio device does not support boost, so volume stops at 100%%.
soundsculptor.trace.notice.bypass: Bypass is on: nothing is changed.
soundsculptor.trace.notice.vanilla_cover: This sound has its own vanilla slider, so Sound Sculptor does not handle it.
soundsculptor.trace.notice.not_heard_yet: Not heard yet; zones depend on where it plays.
soundsculptor.trace.notice.changed_since: Rules or zones changed since this sound last played, so what you heard may differ.
soundsculptor.trace.zone_reason.tie_smal: Tie on distance; smaller zone wins
soundsculptor.trace.zone_reason.tie_list: Tie on distance and size; higher in the list
soundsculptor.trace.text.play_dropped: Last play was dropped by the repeat limit
soundsculptor.trace.edit.error.limit_win: Window must be from %1$s to %2$s ms
soundsculptor.trace.edit.volume.tip: Change this rule's volume. Changes apply at once and can be undone.
soundsculptor.trace.edit.volume_typed.ti: Type a volume, or leave it empty so this rule does not set one
soundsculptor.trace.edit.add_quick.mute_: Mute this exact sound with a new entry in this place's Quick changes
soundsculptor.trace.edit.add_quick.volum: Set this exact sound's volume with a new entry in this place's Quick changes
soundsculptor.recent.why: Why does it sound like this?
soundsculptor.diag.per_sound: Time per sound: average %s µs, max %s µs (peak %s µs)
soundsculptor.diag.tick: Re-checking playing sounds: average %s µs, max %s µs per tick
soundsculptor.diag.outlines: Zone outlines: average %s µs, max %s µs per frame
soundsculptor.diag.active: Sound Sets active: %1$s (%2$s in the library), entries: %3$s, zones: %4$s
soundsculptor.diag.cache.none: Pattern cache hit rate: no sounds yet
soundsculptor.diag.copy.tip: Copy these numbers with the mod and Minecraft versions, for a bug report
soundsculptor.trace.title: Why does it sound like this?
soundsculptor.trace.copy.tip: Copy this trace as plain text, for asking for help or reporting a bug
soundsculptor.search.help.2: villager hurt: contains all the words
soundsculptor.search.help.4: villager hurt | zombie hurt: | splits into groups; spaces inside a group mean all
soundsculptor.search.empty: No sound matches. Try fewer or shorter words.
soundsculptor.zones.new.tip: Create a 10-block box where you stand, then mark its corners or adjust its sides
soundsculptor.zones.hint: Zones change sounds inside them. Overlaps: the closest center wins.
soundsculptor.zones.empty: No zones yet. Use New zone where you want sounds changed.
soundsculptor.zones.turn_off: Turn this zone off without deleting it
soundsculptor.zones.rules.tip: The rules this zone applies to sounds inside it
soundsculptor.zones.delete.title: Delete this zone?
soundsculptor.zones.delete.message: The zone %s and its rules will be deleted. To keep it for later, turn it off instead.
soundsculptor.zone_rules.title: Zone rules
soundsculptor.zone_rules.subtitle: Zone: %s
soundsculptor.zone_rules.empty: No rules yet. Use Add rule; the pattern * means every sound in the zone.
soundsculptor.zone_editor.rules.tip: Save the zone and edit the rules it applies
soundsculptor.zone_editor.enabled.tip: Turn the zone off to stop its effect without deleting it
soundsculptor.zone_editor.my_position.ti: Center the zone where you stand
soundsculptor.zone_editor.looking_at.tip: Center the zone on the block you are looking at
soundsculptor.zone_editor.shape.tip: A sphere around the center, or a box aligned with the world grid
soundsculptor.zone_editor.name: Zone name
soundsculptor.zone_editor.name.tip: Shown in the zone list, in Recently Played and above the zone's outline
soundsculptor.settings.outlines.tip: Draw zones in the world: always, only the zone open in the zone editor, or never. Hotkey: %s.
soundsculptor.settings.through_blocks.ti: Draw outlines and names on top of blocks, so you can see zones behind walls. They are your own zones, so this shows nothing about the world.
soundsculptor.rules.add_existing.tip: Copy a rule from the global list or another zone into this zone. The copy is separate: changing one later does not change the other.
soundsculptor.rule_copy.title: Add existing rule
soundsculptor.rule_copy.hint: Copies are separate: changing one later does not change the other.
soundsculptor.rule_copy.empty: No other rules yet. Rules from the global list and other zones show here.
soundsculptor.rule_copy.copy.tip: Add a copy of this rule to this zone
soundsculptor.rule_copy.duplicate: This zone already has a rule for this pattern; edit that one instead
soundsculptor.no_world: Join a world or server to see and change its sounds. Each one keeps its own rules and zones.
soundsculptor.settings.no_world: The other settings belong to a world or server; join one to change them.
soundsculptor.zone_editor.mark_corners.t: Close this editor, then left-click a block (or press %s) for each of the two corners; looking at nothing marks the block you stand in. The box between them becomes the zone.
soundsculptor.zone_editor.side.tip: The side Grow and Shrink move; the opposite side stays where it is
soundsculptor.zone_editor.shrink.tip: Move the chosen side in by 1 block (Shift: 5 blocks)
soundsculptor.zone_editor.grow.tip: Move the chosen side out by 1 block (Shift: 5 blocks)
soundsculptor.zone_editor.size_label: Size in blocks: width (x), height (y), depth (z)
soundsculptor.marking.controls: Left-click a block (or press %1$s) to mark it · %2$s cancels
soundsculptor.rule_editor.search.many: %1$s sounds match "%2$s" · pick This sound or Like this
soundsculptor.rule_editor.search.one: 1 sound matches "%2$s" · pick This sound or Like this
soundsculptor.rule_editor.search.none: No sound matches "%2$s" · try other words
soundsculptor.rule_editor.this_sound.tip: Make the rule for exactly this sound
soundsculptor.rule_editor.like_this.tip: Make the rule for a family of sounds like this one; choose how wide
soundsculptor.profiles.hint: Each server and world has its own profile.
soundsculptor.profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Join a server or world to make one.
soundsculptor.profiles.folder_fallback: This save is read-only, so its profile uses the folder name.
soundsculptor.profiles.copy.tip: Copy this profile's Sound Sets on Everywhere, bubbles and settings into this world's profile
soundsculptor.profiles.copy.title: Copy from %s?
soundsculptor.profiles.copy.message: Its %1$s Sound Sets on Everywhere, %2$s bubble zones and settings will replace this world's. Library sets stay linked: edits show in both. This world's %3$s fixed zones stay. Fixed zones are never copied.
soundsculptor.profiles.rename.title: Rename profile
soundsculptor.profiles.rename.name: Name
soundsculptor.profiles.rename.name.tip: The name shown for this profile. Its server or world stays the same.
soundsculptor.profiles.reset.title: Reset this profile?
soundsculptor.profiles.reset.message: All rules, zones and settings of %s will be removed. This can't be undone.
soundsculptor.profiles.delete.current: This world's profile can't be deleted. Reset it instead.
soundsculptor.profiles.delete.title: Delete this profile?
soundsculptor.profiles.delete.message: The profile %s will be deleted. Joining that server or world again starts a new, empty profile.
soundsculptor.profiles.own: Give this copy its own profile
soundsculptor.profiles.own.tip: If you copied this world's save folder, the copy shares the original's profile. This gives the copy its own.
soundsculptor.profiles.own.title: Give this world its own profile?
soundsculptor.profiles.own.message: This world gets its own copy of the current rules, zones and settings. The original world keeps the shared profile.
soundsculptor.profiles.own.done: This world now has its own profile
soundsculptor.profiles.own.failed: Could not write the world's ID file, so nothing changed
soundsculptor.transfer.export.tip: Save this profile as a file in config/soundsculptor/exports, with its fixed zones and a copy of every Sound Set it uses
soundsculptor.transfer.exported.title: Profile exported
soundsculptor.transfer.open_imports.tip: Open config/soundsculptor/imports. Put profile files there to import them.
soundsculptor.transfer.import_button.tip: Import a profile file into this world's profile. You can also drop a file on this tab.
soundsculptor.transfer.import_screen.emp: No files yet. Put a .json file in the folder, or drop one on the Profiles tab.
soundsculptor.transfer.import.tip: Check this file and see what it will change
soundsculptor.transfer.import.title: Import %s?
soundsculptor.transfer.import.replace: Its %1$s Sound Sets on Everywhere, %2$s bubble zones and settings will replace this world's.
soundsculptor.transfer.import.fixed: %s fixed zones made for this server will be added.
soundsculptor.transfer.import.skipped: %s fixed zones made for another server will be skipped.
soundsculptor.transfer.import.sets_added: %s Sound Sets will be added to the library.
1 Sound Set will be added to the library.
soundsculptor.transfer.import.ignored: %s unknown settings in the file will be ignored.
soundsculptor.transfer.imported.skipped: Imported %1$s. %2$s fixed zones were skipped (another server).
soundsculptor.transfer.no_world: Join a world or server to import into its profile

soundsculptor.profile.problem.backup_fai: The file could not be backed up before upgrading it: %s
